WA.text: 2027 tide rings print for Long Beach

WA: draws every predicted tide of the year at the south end of the Long Beach Peninsula, with the highest, this January's king tides among them, in an accent color.
OR: draws every predicted tide of the year at Yaquina Bay, with the highest, this January's king tides among them, in an accent color.
CA: draw every predicted tide of the year, with the highest, this January's king tides among them, in an accent color.
custom: can show the predicted tide at a place you choose on one day, a king tide day included.

privacy: The About and king tides pages link to the Tide Hours shop on Etsy, where the print is sold. This site sends nothing to Etsy. The link takes you to Etsy, where Etsy's own privacy policy applies.
